metadata.description: Default survival barrier label contract for sur lane. Long/short trades are labeled based on which barrier (SL or TP) price hits first within a 12-bar (M5) horizon. SL=2.0xATR(14), TP=3.5xATR(14). Regime-adjusted multipliers are applied at runtime by RegimeDetector.
metadata.author: quant-os
metadata.rationale: 12-bar M5 horizon = 1 hour. SL=2.0xATR gives ~1.5-3x average bar range buffer. TP=3.5xATR gives ~1.75:1 reward-to-risk ratio. These are BASE values; live trading adjusts per volatility regime via RegimeDetector.
